findings.title: Bundle-01 authority filenames do not prove tracked root authority; UR-TP-001 must cite tracked canonical paths
repo_evidence: git ls-tree -r b176747 (16058 blobs) blob-id match: 23/32 bundle-01 files byte-identical to a tracked path
git cat-file -e b176747:RULES.md -> ABSENT; :SYSTEM_BOUNDARIES.md -> ABSENT; :TRUTH_SCOPE.md/:TRUTH_SYSTEMS.md/:SYSTEM_Dopemux.md -> ABSENT
bundle PM_PLANE.md blob 3fd5fa11 != tracked root PM_PLANE.md blob 7725d672; bundle AGENTS.md 020793c3 != tracked root AGENTS.md b7bbdac1
governance contracts byte-identical to docs/governance/*, docs/03-reference/governance/*, docs/02-how-to/integrations/dopetask/*
findings.defect: The evidence bundle names files RULES.md, TRUTH_*, SYSTEM_*, system-boundaries.md as authority inputs, but several exact root paths are absent at census and the matching tracked blobs are research-tier or stale-root copies. UR-OQ-001 self-declares this blocks UR-TP-001.
findings.impact: If UR-TP-001 references bundle archive names or research-tier TRUTH_* as canonical authority, it would treat a promoted upload copy as stronger than its traceable source, contradicting the AUTHORITY ORDER.
findings.required_repair: In UR-TP-001, cite the tracked canonical paths (proof-contract.md, handoff-contract.md, adapter-contract.md, adapter-schema.md, proof-bundle-schema.md, dopetask-canonical-spec.json, docs/03-reference/governance/rules.md, docs/03-reference/systems/system-boundaries.md) and the current tracked PROJECT.md/ARCHITECTURE.md/SERVICE_CATALOG.md/PM_PLANE.md/AGENTS.md. Treat TRUTH_* as research-tier context only. This audit supplies the Git evidence UR-OQ-001 requested.

findings.title: Certification scope tuple omits identity_confidence and task_class required by the audit prompt
repo_evidence: n/a — architecture-internal completeness check against prompt EVALUATION AND CERTIFICATION AUDIT scope tuple
architecture_evidence: 10_RUNNER_ADAPTER_ARCHITECTURE.md: adapter certification tuple includes benchmark_corpus_version but not identity_confidence or task_class
07_CONTRACT_CATALOG.md:BenchmarkCertification route tuple = runner+provider path+model+reasoning+adapter+policy (omits identity_confidence, task_class, containment, network)
findings.defect: The prompt requires certification scoped to at least 12 members including identity_confidence and task_class. The architecture's certification/adapter/benchmark tuples omit identity_confidence and task_class as explicit tuple members; BenchmarkCertification additionally omits containment and network posture.
findings.impact: A certification could be treated as valid across differing identity-confidence levels or task classes, weakening exactly the identity-sensitive and class-scoped guarantees the architecture otherwise enforces. Affects future benchmark/execution/automatic-routing phases, not first-release advisory output.
findings.required_repair: Add identity_confidence and task_class as explicit certification-tuple members and include containment_profile and network_posture in BenchmarkCertification's route tuple; make any change to these invalidate certification.

findings.title: Contracts are prose 'minimal-field' lists; strict types/required-optional/JSON schemas are deferred to UR-TP-001 and must be produced before the packet is complete
repo_evidence: git ls-tree b176747 -- schemas/universal-router -> 0 entries (schemas do not yet exist; they are UR-TP-001 deliverables)
architecture_evidence: 07_CONTRACT_CATALOG.md: fields given as 'Minimal fields' without explicit types, required-vs-optional, or full enum sets for several fields (effective_route_risk, containment_class, score_components, ranking_weights, next_action, cost_ceiling shape)
findings.defect: Per the prompt, a prose-only contract with unresolved semantics is INCOMPLETE. Ownership, authority, refs, invariants and relationship constraints are complete, but exact field typing/cardinality/enum closure is not yet specified.
findings.impact: Non-authority residual choices (e.g., cost_ceiling scalar vs {amount,currency}) remain to the implementer. These are ordinary schema decisions, not authority guesses, but the packet cannot be marked complete until strict schemas + valid/invalid/unknown/conflicting fixtures exist.
findings.required_repair: UR-TP-001 must deliver strict versioned schemas (additionalProperties:false for authority-bearing sections) with explicit types, required/optional flags, closed enums, and fixtures — which is already the packet's stated gate. Complete before UR-TP-001 sign-off.

findings.title: Canonical PR Steward invocation is UNKNOWN (UR-OQ-006) and gates the merge step of every repo-changing packet incl. UR-TP-001
repo_evidence: grep universal_router|dopemux route across repo -> only 6 doc mentions, no runtime router or PR Steward canonical command bound in the router package
architecture_evidence: 19_MACRO_PACKET_SERIES.md: 'Every executable child packet must pin the current canonical PR Steward invocation before opening the PR. Failure to locate it is a stop condition.'
findings.defect: The PR Steward canonical runtime command is unresolved. Local implementation and validation of UR-TP-001 can proceed, but PR Steward READY (required for merge) cannot be produced until the invocation is pinned.
findings.impact: UR-TP-001 is EXECUTABLE_AFTER_PATH_RESOLUTION rather than executable-as-written: the merge gate is blocked until the canonical PR Steward command is located. This is a resolution step, not a design defect; the architecture correctly forbids building a replacement.
findings.required_repair: Before opening the UR-TP-001 PR, locate and pin the current canonical PR Steward invocation and MERGE_READINESS.json schema at the implementation commit; do not build a substitute inside the router.

findings.title: Trigger-based append-only journal is process-local integrity, not tamper-evidence against an actor with DB write access
architecture_evidence: 04_ADR:'append-only through application rules plus BEFORE UPDATE and BEFORE DELETE triggers that abort mutation'
05_TARGET_ARCHITECTURE.md: event includes 'parent event, policy hash, and redacted payload hash'
findings.defect: BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE triggers can be bypassed by any process that can DROP TRIGGER or open the SQLite file directly. The event record includes parent_event + payload hash but no explicit hash-chain (each event committing the prior event's hash), so silent history rewrite is not made cryptographically detectable.
findings.impact: Adequate for first-release advisory evidence (journal is evidence, not executable state) but not a strong tamper-evidence guarantee. Non-blocking.
findings.required_repair: Consider hash-chaining journal events (event_hash = H(payload_hash || prev_event_hash)) so tampering is detectable on replay; document that triggers provide integrity, not tamper-proofing.

findings.title: Per-worktree journal path fragments decision history across the repository's many worktrees
repo_evidence: journal path <repo_root>/.dopemux/universal-router/router.sqlite3; git rev-parse --show-toplevel resolves per-worktree
.worktrees/ contains ~31 linked worktrees in the live repo
.gitignore:299 '.dopemux/' -> journal path is gitignored (workspace write, not tracked repo write) [OBSERVED, supports READ_ONLY posture]
architecture_evidence: 04_ADR:'Router state is workspace-bound to avoid cross-repository privacy and authority leakage'
findings.defect: Because the journal lives under the resolved worktree root and the repo uses many linked worktrees, decision history is per-worktree and not shared. This is intentional workspace-scoping but not documented as an operator-visible consequence.
findings.impact: Operators inspecting decisions from a different worktree will see an empty/partial journal. No safety impact; the gitignored path confirms journal writes do not touch tracked repo state (a positive for the READ_ONLY posture).
findings.required_repair: Document per-worktree journal semantics for operators; optionally allow an explicit shared journal location under governance; confirm the journal path remains gitignored in UR-TP-003.
